column1: # Game profile of Super Nintendo Entertainment System – Nintendo Classics (Switch, update 6.0.0 = v1966080 over the base game). Plays on the Mac
# Nintendo's own SNES emulator app (a Lua UI over its own NVN renderer), SDK 20.5.21 with NPLN / gRPC, Mnpp and LDN linked in; offline it answers like every other offline game (no network,
# no network service account). Shaders: 10 GLSLC outputs in bootapp/resources/shaders/*.nvnc, 2 in sysdata/shaders/*.glslc, and the GLSLC outputs in main (23 stage shaders).
# The update's ExeFS carries subsdk0 as a byte-identical copy of sdk (the base game's subsdk0–2 are other modules); both are loaded, as on Horizon

# Game name: only a label for profile listings and the Mac window title; the iOS app name is the game name in the base NSP, and the bundle ID comes from the base game title ID (build_ipa.sh / NSP script)

column2: Super Nintendo Entertainment System – Nintendo Classics
